hypothesis: VIX percentile at trade entry is a reliable quality signal. Rather than binary filtering (rejected EXP-0013), modulating position size by VIX bucket improves risk-adjusted returns while preserving trade count.
base_config: P70_L40d adaptive ATR + VIX×1.1 dynamic IV (validated EXP-0011, EXP-0014). 1,522 trades, 2023-2025.

key_signal_from_exp0013.sweet_spot: VIX 50-60th percentile — avg ₹547/trade, 32% win rate (note: with 1.1x IV scale, ₹492/trade)

kelly_insight: Kelly fractions for the danger zone (0.026) vs sweet spot (0.181) are 7:1. This quantitatively confirms the sizing intuition: danger zone trades warrant only ~3% capital allocation vs ~18% for sweet spot. The gradient sizing config empirically approximates Kelly-optimal allocation.

FINDING-1.title: ALL four VIX sizing configs PASS — VIX quality sizing is a validated signal
FINDING-1.detail: Every config that reduces danger zone exposure and/or tilts toward sweet spot produces better Sharpe than flat 1x (2.87). Best Sharpe: Tilt at 2.93 (+0.06). Best total P&L: Gradient at ₹509,446 (+15.6% vs flat). All configs also reduce max drawdown from 39.4% to 31-34%.

FINDING-2.title: Tilt (sweet 1.5x + danger 0.5x) is the recommended config for paper trading
FINDING-2.detail: Only two sizing rules. Produces Sharpe 2.93 (+0.06 vs flat), +6% total P&L, -6pp max drawdown, 30/34 months positive. The simplicity makes it robust and easy to implement in real time: at trade entry, look up today's VIX percentile, apply 1.5x if 50-60th, 0.5x if 60-75th, else 1x.

FINDING-3.title: Gradient config adds +15.6% total P&L but more complex to implement
FINDING-3.detail: 5-bucket gradient (p<20: 1.2x; 20-40: 1.0x; 40-50: 1.1x; 50-60: 1.5x; 60-75: 0.5x; >75: 1.1x) produces ₹509,446 total — the highest of all configs. Sharpe 2.92 (+0.05). However, months positive drops to 28/34 vs 29/34 for Tilt, meaning slightly more variance. Recommended only if implementation complexity is acceptable.

FINDING-4.title: Danger zone sizing reduction is the primary driver; sweet spot upsizing is secondary
FINDING-4.detail: Defensive config (danger zone 0.5x only, no upsizing) achieves Sharpe 2.91 and 30/34 months positive with -1% total P&L. Most of the risk-reduction benefit comes from simply sizing down the 216 danger zone trades (Kelly fraction 0.026) rather than sizing up elsewhere. The upsizing in the sweet spot adds P&L but also adds tail risk.

FINDING-5.title: August 2025 shows sweet spot sizing risk: +₹27,018 flat → +₹18,794 Tilt
FINDING-5.detail: Aug 2025 had 5 sweet spot trades that lost money. At 1.5x sizing, those losses were amplified. This is the fundamental risk of position sizing UP: when the 'good' bucket has a bad run, you lose more. The 32% win rate in the sweet spot means 68% of sweet spot trades still lose.

FINDING-6.title: Kelly analysis validates danger zone reduction quantitatively
FINDING-6.detail: Kelly fraction for danger zone (VIX 60-75th): 0.026 — Kelly says bet almost nothing here. For sweet spot (50-60th): 0.181 — bet moderately. The 7:1 Kelly ratio between sweet spot and danger zone theoretically validates the 1.5x vs 0.5x sizing choice (3:1 ratio in our Tilt config, conservative vs Kelly's 7:1).

recommended_implementation.rule: At trade entry, compute rolling 40-day VIX percentile. If 50th ≤ pctile < 60th: trade 1.5 lots (or proportionally scale premium). If 60th ≤ pctile < 75th: trade 0.5 lots. Otherwise: trade 1 lot (standard).
recommended_implementation.capital_note: At ₹20k starting capital, 1 lot is standard. 1.5 lots requires ₹30k available. Minimum recommended capital for Tilt config: ₹50k (allows 1.5x sizing without margin pressure).
recommended_implementation.data_dependency: Requires live India VIX feed — available via Upstox Analytics API (NSE_INDEX|India VIX). Already wired in data pipeline.

conclusion: HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. VIX percentile sizing modulation improves risk-adjusted returns. All four configs pass. Recommended config: Tilt (sweet 1.5x + danger 0.5x) — Sharpe 2.93, +6% total P&L, max drawdown reduced from 39.4% to 33.7%. The danger zone (VIX 60-75th pctile) is now quantified: Kelly fraction 0.026 vs sweet spot 0.181, confirming that this bucket deserves minimal capital allocation. The Tilt config is ready for paper trading integration alongside P70_L40d ATR filter and VIX×1.1 dynamic IV model.
